desc: Ideation: sliding window over root-to-node path with last-occurrence map and monotonic boundary.
Implement full solution: adjacency list, DFS (recursive with setrecursionlimit or iterative), state tracking with backtracking, answer updates.
Verify against Example 1 (expect [6,2]) and Example 2 (expect [0,1]), plus edge cases: single-edge duplicates, deep chains (recursion limit), all-same values, all-unique values.
